title: Apollyon, the Howl at World's End
description: Cheap spirits multiply, then rise as one devouring chorus.

title: Apollyon, the Last Causality
description: Each event births another, until consequence becomes catastrophe.

title: Apollyon, Marshal of the Final Host
description: Warriors gather behind sharpened ranks and strike before mercy.

title: Apollyon, the Butcher of the Unfallen
description: Every sacrifice feeds survivors who refuse to stay dead.

title: Apollyon, the Crawling Return
description: Small dead things return endlessly, profiting from every crossing.

title: Apollyon, the Closed Grave
description: Free souls cycle through death, scoring value with each return.

title: Apollyon, Keeper of Cast-Off Names
description: Discarded cards become omens, then return sharper than before.

title: Apollyon, Sovereign of the Full Void
description: The void swells quickly, then empties itself into victory.

title: Apollyon, the Unplaceable
description: Phasing outsiders slip past danger while disordering every defense.

title: Apollyon, Herald of the Roused Blade
description: Events awaken warriors into sudden, repeated bursts of violence.
